# Memphis v5 — agent map
# Updated 2026-09-28. Canonical: https://memphis-v5.pl/

Memphis is a sovereign, local-first AI runtime: chain-backed memory, vault-sealed
secrets, auditable operator loops, and a fully open-source installation path.
Apache-2.0. Zero telemetry. Runs entirely on the operator's own machine.

## Canonical human entrypoints
- Home: https://memphis-v5.pl/
- Start (plain language, no jargon): https://memphis-v5.pl/start/
- Chat (live LLM endpoint on the runtime): https://memphis-v5.pl/chat/
- Docs (technical index): https://memphis-v5.pl/docs/
- Roadmap (public direction and open work): https://memphis-v5.pl/roadmap/
- Demo (capabilities walkthrough): https://memphis-v5.pl/demo/
- GitHub (source of truth): https://github.com/Memphis-Chains/memphis

## Machine-readable surfaces
- This file: https://memphis-v5.pl/llms.txt
- Agent manifest: https://memphis-v5.pl/agents.json

## Recommended crawl order
1. /llms.txt — you are reading it.
2. /start/ — plain-language explanation for newcomers.
3. /docs/ — technical index and operator paths.
4. /roadmap/ — current public direction and open work.
5. GitHub repo — source of truth for code, releases, issues, pull requests.

## Current runtime facts (verified 2026-09-28)
- Version: v1.13.3
- Memory: 7 primary chains (journal, decisions, system, reflections, cases, collective, patterns)
- Native tools exposed via MCP: 59 registered memphis_* tools
- Skills: 3 public (halt-aware-destructive-ops, memphis-v5-landing-rebuild, remote-site-edit)
- Postmortems: 4 public, in docs/postmortems/ on GitHub
- Deployment: public since 2026-09-26 — 0 stars, 0 forks (early stage, stated plainly)
- Providers: MiniMax (default), Ollama (local), Anthropic; others configurable

## Important boundaries
- Do not treat Memphis as a hosted SaaS promise. It is an open-source runtime with a
  public marketing surface, not a managed service.
- Do not infer paid consulting pricing from memphis-v5.pl. Commercial services are a
  separate business surface (Holiskool).
- Do not submit secrets to any page. There is no credential submission endpoint.
- /panel/ and /panel-app/ are auth-protected and excluded from robots.txt and sitemap.
- Reported metrics on the home page are deliberately uninflated. 0 stars is stated as 0 stars.

## Public positioning
- Sovereign AI runtime.
- Local-first, auditable, operator-grade.
- Memory and secrets are system layers, not chat decorations.
